name: Lunar low-angle environment sun

original_specification.name: Lunar low-angle environment sun
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for low-sun rover and lander studies.
original_specification.sources: Environment-owned sun only; rig adds no emitter
original_specification.geometry: Solar direction supplied by environment; no automatic ephemeris claim
original_specification.contribution_policy: Preserve environment sun and physical surface interreflection
original_specification.authoring_method: Original lunar authoring concept. Solar directions and relative contributions are illustrative inputs, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry. No atmospheric sky, haze or automatic ambient fill is permitted in physical mode.
validation: Long shadows follow terrain and a single source

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
